newsitem.title: USA: Ronson Corp extends preferred offer.
newsitem.headline: Ronson Corp extends preferred offer.

text.p: Ronson Corp said on Monday it extended its offer for the exchange of its 12 percent cumulative convertible preferred shares for common shares, at a ratio of 1.7 common shares for each preferred share.
The offer, due to expire today, was extended to January 21, the company said. All other terms were the same, it said.
Ronson also said the exchange offer was effective and it was proceeding with the offer.
It said it has received about 50 percent of the preferred shares for exchange under the offer terms.
